newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all gain ground on U.S., strike.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all gain ground on U.S., strike.

text.p: NWE oil products were stronger on Thursday helped by U.S demand and the French strike.
Naphtha ended higher. End-users said NWE supplies were adequate but traders said strong crude and arbitrage interest to the U.S. were boosting swaps.
Gasoline rose sharply as French demand created by the Elf strike and a healthy U.S. appetite tightened supply.
Gas oil rose $5.50 on futures. Cargo premiums were well supported by the French strike. Barge premiums fell.
Fuel oil was bouyed stronger, high sulphur by crude and low sulphur by fundamentals. -- +44 171 542 8980
